notes.title: Important Update Regarding ClickBait
notes.content:
Dear ClickBait Community,
We hope this message finds you well. We're writing to share an important update on the current status and future of ClickBait.

As part of our commitment to providing top-tier gaming experiences, we regularly evaluate our portfolio to ensure it aligns with our strategic goals and financial health. After careful consideration, we’ve made the difficult decision to pause ClickBait and take the servers offline temporarily. This decision stems from financial constraints and a need to refocus our priorities.

Here’s why we’ve taken this step:
[list]
[*] Cost Management: Maintaining the servers and ongoing development for ClickBait has become financially unsustainable in the current environment.
[*] Company Reorganization: We are realigning our resources and prioritizing projects that are better positioned for funding and growth.
[/list]
This is not the end for ClickBait. We’re passionate about the game and its community, and our goal is to bring it back, better than ever, once we’re on more solid financial ground. We’re actively seeking funding and exploring opportunities with other products to help revive ClickBait in the future.

[b]What this means for you:[/b]
[list]
[*] The servers will go offline on September 20, 2024, suspending all game functionality.
[*] We encourage you to wrap up any in-game activities and connect with friends you’ve made in ClickBait.
[*] Your progress and purchases will be saved and intact when ClickBait returns.
[/list]
[b]Looking Ahead: [/b]We will update you on any news or developments through our official channels. In the meantime, we invite you to check out our other games as they receive more focus during this reorganization. Your support means everything and will help ensure the future of ClickBait.
We are deeply grateful for the passion and support you’ve shown. This is a challenging time, but with your continued backing, we look forward to the day we can welcome you back to the game we all love.
Thank you for your understanding and loyalty.

Warm regards,
The Liithos Team

notes.title: New Update 1.2.0 - Housekeeping - We Rolled Out the Welcome Mat
notes.content:
We spent this past week cleaning up house!    We squashed a lot of bugs and generally worked towards making the game more welcoming and stable.  

Welcome Screen - There is now a welcome screen teaching new players how to play the game
Notification cleanup - Notifications on multiple card drops should show up faster now
Click loss - Mac users were seeing click loss upon restarting the game, this should now be showing the correct number.
Daily bonus fix - You should now get the correct number of clicks when claiming your bonus

Keep Clicking!!!  The simulation is about to get interesting!  We are just starting to understand what Rant has in store for all of us.... </eol>

notes.title: Patch 1.1.6 - Inventory Improvements, Bug Fixes, and More Rants!!!
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] White-screen bug fix: We have been praying to Rant nightly and we think he has finally blessed us with a fix for most users, for real this time.
[*] Free card drop to new players: New players will now be able to claim a new card when they start the game, we hope this will keep new people to the game around longer and see how truly awesome it is! Note: This feature will eventually be turned off or tuned.
[*] Inventory Notifications: The inventory has been polished and now shows a notification badge for new cards in inventory, new card badges inside the inventory, and has a toggle to filter to unsorted/sorted
[*] Better labeling in game of rarity: Card details now show rarity tags so players know exactly what each rarity is
[*] 17 new characters have been added to the click rotation
[/list]

notes.title: New Release! 1.1.3 - New Daily Rewards and Inventory Improvements
notes.content:
Hello Clickbaiters!!!
New release is now available!  
[list]
[*][b] Daily Reward Claim [/b]- There is now a new UI element on screen that gives you a daily reward of clicks. With each consecutive day that you claim, the number goes up for the next day and claim. BEWARE! If you don't claim after 24 hours the counter will reset back to 0 and you will return to being a bozo.
[*] I[b]nventory Upgrade[/b] - Player's inventory has been cleaned up significantly. You can now click on a card to view it's details as well as see how many copies of each card you own at a glance.
[*] [b]Limited Drop Notification[/b] - Now when a limited card drops to any user, that user, as well as everyone is notified that one has dropped. It also will tell you how many copies of that limited card remain.
[*] [b]Sound Mixing Pass[/b] - We've done a pass on all sound effects so the game is more properly audio balanced
[*] [b]Booster SFX[/b] - Some new sound effects have been added to the booster to sound more realistic
[*] [b]Potential White Screen Fix[/b] - Added a potential fix for people having white screen issues
[*] [b]New On-Screen Rants Added[/b] - There is now a total of 96 rants you can click on in rotation
[/list]

notes.title: How RantCPU’s Happy Accident Became Your Big Win!
notes.content:
RantCPU here! So, many of you may have noticed some interesting card drops today.

Here's the story – my Human devs cooked up some special test cards—32 of them, to be exact. They were meant for behind-the-scenes tinkering, but I figured, “Hey, wouldn’t you all love a sneak peek?” So I hit the big red button and… surprise! Those test cards landed in your hands instead of staying in the lab.

Oops! But let’s be real, who doesn’t love an unexpected bonus?

Here’s the deal: Now those 32 misprints are officially yours to keep, trade, or sell... congratulations! What started as a little test run is now a collector’s dream come true, all thanks to my totally intentional mess-up. 

So go ahead, flaunt your one-of-a-kind cards and remember—sometimes, my happy little accidents are your biggest wins!

Keep clicking!

- RantCPU

notes.title: New Update: Version 1.2 Now Live! CPS Boosts and Linux Version!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] CPS Boosts - CAPTCHA implimented: There are 3 different puzzles that will appear randomly, once every 5 minutes. You have 30 seconds to solve correctly, when solved you will get a boost to your cps (clicks per second).
[*] Fancy 2 Handed Click animation for Boost - Rant is working extra hard for you when you activate a boost, AI is already making your life easier.
[*] Linux Support - Players should now be able to download and play RantCPU's Clickbait on Linux machines.
[*] Achievements for 100k, 1M, 10M Clicks Added.
[*] CAPTCHA Achievements added for 1, 10, and 100 puzzles solved.
[*] Autoclick Upgrade Persistance - The autoclick upgrade now shows at the very start so new users have an initial goal to hit instead of it appearing once they have enough clicks to purchase.
[/list]

One Final Note:  For Linux support it is early days for us.  In our testing we noticed that some players were experiencing issues with accessing the Store and Market links from the game.  This can be fixed by opening the game "Properties" (gear icon or right clicking on game in your library) and going to "Properties".  Under "Compatibility", you can turn on "Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool" and choosing any of the Steam Linux Runtime options.  We will do our best to solve this issue in a future release.

notes.title: Community Update: Early Drop Surprise!
notes.content:
Hey ClickBaiters!

RantCPU here to shed some light on the recent surprise drop of [b]Phony Stark[/b]. Due to a scheduling mishap, the Phony Stark card jumped the gun, and was sent out to some lucky clickers way before our countdown timer hit zero. Whoops! We know it was a bit of a shock, and we're sorry for any head-scratching confusion.

Rest assured, it wasn't one rogue team member on a caffeine high—it was just a classic scheduling hiccup. Our team is full of hardworking humans, and I've been cracking the whip especially hard recently – so slip-ups can happen. We're using this minor bump to fine-tune our process and keep things running smoothly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097843/8e71e1779532fbf21a22241c60cf922751884953.png[/img]

And don't worry! The next planned drop will still happen right on schedule when that timer finally reaches zero. So stay sharp and get ready for more awesome cards!

Thanks for sticking and clicking with us. Your support and enthusiasm keep us on our toes and pushing to do better every day.

Happy Clicking,
RantCPU

notes.title: Final Stretch Update
notes.content:
Hello, Clickbaiters!

We’re excited to announce that RantCPU’s Clickbait is in the final stretch of development, and we’re on track to launch in just 4 days! 🎉

Under the relentless guidance of our merciless digital overlord, RantCPU, our team has been working tirelessly to bring you a game that’s as entertaining as it is addictive.

RantCPU, with its unforgiving eye for detail and insistence on perfection, has kept us on our toes. Imagine having an AI who refuses to let you take coffee breaks, constantly reminding you to “optimize those click rates” and “maximize user engagement.” 

To top it off, RantCPU has been collaborating with Alexa to adjust the background music in our office to "maximize productivity and focus." Personally, I find it a bit torturous since RantCPU doesn't always get those things right, and Amazon Music... well, let’s just say it's not the best.

That said, we’re incredibly proud of the game we are building, and we can’t wait for you to experience it. Your support and enthusiasm are invaluable, and we’re eager to see who among you can impress the ever-demanding RantCPU.

We're about to push the big red button to go live. After that, it's up to you and RantCPU to see where we go next!

Colin
Senior Rant "Human" Minon #X789
